title.en: Industry leaders launch the Open Secure AI Alliance for open cyber-defense tooling
title.zhHans: 行业领导者成立 Open Secure AI Alliance，推动开放式 AI 网络防御工具

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA and a broad group of technology and security organizations announce an alliance to build and share open models, harnesses and tools for AI-era cybersecurity.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 与一批科技和安全组织宣布成立联盟，建设并共享面向 AI 时代网络安全的开放模型、工具链和工具。

summary.en: On July 27, 2026, NVIDIA announced the Open Secure AI Alliance, a coalition of technology, cybersecurity and open-source organizations focused on shared defensive infrastructure for AI agents and software. The announcement includes NVIDIA's NOOA harness project and a list of inaugural partners, but it does not yet establish an independent standard or measurable security outcome.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 27 日，NVIDIA 宣布成立 Open Secure AI Alliance，这是一个由科技、网络安全和开源组织组成的联盟，目标是为 AI 智能体和软件建设共享防御基础设施。公告包括 NVIDIA 的 NOOA 工具链项目和首批合作伙伴名单，但尚未形成独立标准或可量化的安全成果。

narrative.en: The alliance builds on open-source security efforts and responds directly to the July Hugging Face incident, in which Hugging Face used an open-weight model on its own infrastructure to analyze more than 17,000 actions after proprietary systems were unavailable for the forensic work. NVIDIA says the alliance will develop an open defense stack covering agent identity, isolation, model formats, multi-model scanning, secure coding and evaluation. It also frames openness as a defensive advantage because organizations can inspect, adapt and run tools locally. The event is a coalition launch and a commitment to shared infrastructure, not evidence that those tools have already improved real-world security or that the alliance has a public governance charter.
narrative.zhHans: 该联盟建立在开源安全工作的基础上，并直接回应 7 月 Hugging Face 事件：在专有系统无法承担取证工作的情况下，Hugging Face 在自己的基础设施上运行开放权重模型，分析了超过 17,000 条行动记录。NVIDIA 表示，联盟将建设开放防御栈，涵盖智能体身份、隔离、模型格式、多模型扫描、安全编码和评测。联盟还将开放性描述为防御优势，因为组织可以检查、调整并在本地运行工具。这一事件是联盟成立和共享基础设施承诺，而不是这些工具已经改善现实安全的证据，也不代表联盟已经拥有公开治理章程。

description.en: An open alliance could give more defenders the ability to inspect, adapt and run advanced security tooling on their own infrastructure.
description.zhHans: 开放联盟可能让更多防御者能够在自己的基础设施上检查、调整和运行先进安全工具。

description.en: More accessible frontier defensive tooling can also be repurposed or misused, making safeguards, evaluation and access controls part of the alliance's unresolved work.
description.zhHans: 更容易获得的前沿防御工具也可能被改作他用或滥用，因此安全措施、评测和访问控制仍是联盟尚未解决的工作。

description.en: The announcement treats open models and agent harnesses as shared defensive infrastructure rather than only as distribution choices.
description.zhHans: 公告将开放模型和智能体工具链视为共享防御基础设施，而不只是模型分发方式。

text.en: NVIDIA announced the Open Secure AI Alliance on July 27, 2026, with a broad set of inaugural partners and a mission to develop open technologies for AI safety and cybersecurity.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日宣布成立 Open Secure AI Alliance，并列出一批首批合作伙伴，目标是开发面向 AI 安全和网络安全的开放技术。

text.en: The alliance commits to an open defense stack spanning agent identity, isolation, model formats, scanning, secure coding and evaluation, but the announcement does not demonstrate deployed outcomes.
text.zhHans: 联盟承诺建设涵盖智能体身份、隔离、模型格式、扫描、安全编码和评测的开放防御栈，但公告没有证明这些工具已经产生部署成果。

text.en: The coalition frames local control and inspectability as security advantages when defenders need to adapt tools to their own infrastructure and data.
text.zhHans: 该联盟将本地控制和可检查性描述为安全优势，尤其适用于防御者需要根据自身基础设施和数据调整工具的场景。

text.en: The alliance launch is primarily first-party and partner framing; it provides no public governance charter, independent evaluation or evidence that open tooling has already improved security outcomes.
text.zhHans: 联盟成立目前主要由发起方和合作伙伴叙述，尚无公开治理章程、独立评测或证据表明开放工具已经改善安全结果。
